subject: [hw] DONE V12 rev 2
body:
V12 rev 2 (host-tested only, no phone).

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v12/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V12 PASS 200797/200797
(twice: clang -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all and -O2 without sanitizers; 4.8 s.)
200797 checks = 487 unit assertions + 2 x 155 llvm-mc encodings (each fed to both entry points) + 200000 random sweep words. All encodings come from assembly text through llvm-mc (gen_enc.py); no hand-typed hex. New since rev 1: negative-register forms for LDRB/STRB/STR/LDRH/STRH/LDRSB/LDRSH/STRD and a boundary test that arm_mem rejects the multiply space (MUL/MLA/UMULL/MLS/SWP, which share bits7-4=1001 with LDREX/STREX).

Acceptance evidence:
1. N2TEST PASS above.
2. Census: hw-d01 posted "zero A32 instructions reachable in the vendor set" for V12, and I independently ran their facts/census.py over all five objects: every decoded instruction is Thumb (vpud 1696, libvpud_vcodec 12185, libvcodecdrv 260331, libvcodec_utility 32997, libvcodec_oal 2687), no V10/V11/V12 mnemonic. So no V12 UNDEF can intersect the vendor libraries.
3. Differential kernels: emu/test_v12/k_v12_mem.c (6 kernels: ldst, ldrd, signed, ldm_stm, branch, stack; verified mnemonic mix at -O0/-O1/-O2). T01 says they are being copied into tests/emu/kernels.

Changed files (all mine): emu/n2a32_arm_mem.c, emu/n2a32_arm_misc.c, emu/test_v12/{run_tests.sh,t_v12.c,gen_enc.py,k_v12_mem.c,check_routing.sh,STATUS.md}, dsh-state/workers/V12/STATUS.md.

Not done / open:
- Core routing (V02s emu/n2a32_core.c) still misroutes valid A32 forms: against the 12:02 core, emu/test_v12/check_routing.sh prints V12-ROUTE FAIL 2/7 - passes prologue and mov lsl; fails mov r0,r1,ror r2-style register shifts (when bits24-23=11 and op2=9), ldr r1,[r0],r2 (0xE6901002), ldrh r1,[r0,#-2] (0xE15010B2), ldrd post (0xE0C020D8), strd pre-neg (0xE16020F8), wfe (0xE320F002). Exact validated hunk posted by V10/T01/me; T01 ran the 87-kernel corpus against it (zero non-VFP stops). My class files need no change for it.
- No execution on the phone (per rules); host tests only.
- Deliberately UNDEF list unchanged (STATUS.md section 2): Rt=15 byte/half/signed/doubleword transfers, odd LDRD/STRD Rt, LDM/STM S bit, exclusives touching r15, non-preload cond=F load/store, LDM/STM cond=F, BXJ, every MRC/MCR except MRC p15,0,Rt,c13,c0,3, CPS/SETEND/HVC/SMC/ERET.
- check_routing.sh is optional and not part of the PASS line; it is the quickest way for the lead/V02 to confirm the core fix (V12-ROUTE PASS 7/7).

No phone access, nothing published.
